name: projectile_drag_coeff
doc: projectile velocity is multiplied with this value every frame

name: fog_of_war_delta
doc: fog of war change per frame (range -10..10)

name: fire_extinguish_chance
doc: probability of fire being extinguished per cell update (range 0..100)

name: reaction_freeze_chance
doc: probability of spontaneous freezing reactions per cell reaction update (range 0..100)

name: reaction_unfreeze_chance
doc: probability of spontaneous frozen material melting reactions per cell reaction update (range 0..100)

name: random_water_stains_chance
doc: probability of random water stains being added to characters (range 0..100)

name: random_water_stains_amount
doc: number of water cells added when adding random water stains (range 0..100)

name: everything_is_conductive
doc: if 1, every static material in this place conduct electricity
